<!--
Say what is now true and why it had to change. The commit subjects in this repository are
sentences of that kind; a pull request description is the same thing with room to explain.
-->

## What a reviewer should look at

<!-- The one decision or the one file that deserves a second pair of eyes, rather than the diff. -->

## How to see it working

<!--
The commands, the route, the document. Screenshots or a short recording for anything visual —
a value is right or wrong because of how it looks, and that does not survive being described.
-->

## Before it merges

- [ ] The verification chain in `CONTRIBUTING.md` passes locally; `verify` says so here too.
- [ ] Commits follow `AGENTS.md`: English, a subject that says what is now true, no AI attribution.
- [ ] `docs/`, a README or the catalogue says the new thing, if this changed what the product does.
